body: Paimon's kit dispatch existed from an earlier, uncommitted pass but was never actually reachable: missing arena_hero_name()/arena_ability_name() entries, pick-validation bound stuck at ARENA_HERO_TYLER, draft-modulo in both bot and human clients still % 18, and no tick_hero_kit/bot_cast_kit_if_ready case (confirmed via a real compiler warning). Fixed all five gaps, added a distinct 3D silhouette, and 5 new headless tests. Verified live: rebuilt + restarted all three systemd units, confirmed Paimon (hero_id=18) actually gets drafted in a genuine 20/20 match and runs stably. Commit e12cf91.
title: Finish wiring Paimon into the live roster (S170-55)
